query.name: cursor
query.description:
Base64-url-encoded cursor for cursor-based pagination. Omit on the first request or pass the literal string `"null"`; on subsequent requests, pass the `pagination.nextCursor` value returned by the previous response. When `nextCursor` is the literal string `"null"`, the end of the result set has been reached.

Requires `sortBy` to be set; `sortBy` and `sortOrder` (default `ASC`) must match the values used when the cursor was issued, otherwise the request fails with HTTP 400. A malformed cursor returns HTTP 400 `invalid cursor`. The query filters must be preserved across multiple requests fetching subsequent pages.
